title: I’ve been improving combat in Portal Beasts. how does it look?
author: PortalBeasts
selftext:
I’ve been working on making combat in Portal Beasts feel smoother and more responsive. Here’s some gameplay showing the updated battles and a few different beast abilities!

I’d love some honest feedback do the attacks feel impactful, and is it easy to follow what’s happening? What would you improve?

Here's the link: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4167720/Portal\_Beasts/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4167720/Portal_Beasts/)

comments.author: Offbeat_voyage
comments.body: Love the way it looks. You should contact gym leader ed and get your game showcased he specializes on monster taming games

replies.author: PortalBeasts
replies.body: Thank you, I really appreciate that! I’ve thought about reaching out to Gym Leader Ed, but I saw a video where he expressed concerns about AI art in games. Portal Beasts does use some AI-assisted art, especially for animations, so I’ve been a little hesitant.

replies.author: Offbeat_voyage
replies.body: Expressing concern is fine doesn't mean he won't show it, it never hurts to ask and write an email and ask if that something he would be willing to cover even though it has ai

comments.author: Fancy_Palpitation_38
comments.body:
Love the way this looks

What was your workflow?

replies.author: PortalBeasts
replies.body: Thank you! I’m building it in Godot, using Codex Astra to help with coding and PixelLab for AI-assisted animations. Happy to go into more detail if you’re curious is there a particular part of the workflow you’d like to know more about?

replies.author: Fancy_Palpitation_38
replies.body: Nah your doing great. Just wanted to let you know it doesnt look like AI! Can't wait to see how this one develops i have wishlisted on steam

replies.author: PortalBeasts
replies.body: Thank you so much, and thanks for wishlisting! I’m really glad to hear that I’ve spent a lot of time refining and adjusting the art myself to make everything feel consistent, so that means a lot!
